item.description: This is something that comes up semi-regularly. Enough times that I've decided a blog post is due: an application supports SCIM. Entra can do SCIM. SailPoint can do SCIM. Someone asks the reasonable question: why would we build a SailPoint connector when Entra will do...

item.title: Designing Team Based Access
item.description: At the start of 2026, under the vision of the newly formed SailPoint engineering function, I set myself the task of finally getting RBAC (or team based access) set up and working. I'd never really considered the different acronyms of what I would be implementing....
